text:
Alex: heads up — noticed some warmstart failures when the new gzipped-safetensors blobs are served without a sidecar index. hotstart tries index-first and then stalls.
Kai: ugh. is this the case where runtime expects a header with chunk counts?
Alex: yeah. current loaders assume either an attached .idx or full index-first manifest. if neither present we fall back to serial range reads which OOMs under concurrent hotstarts.
Maria: quick thought: can we add a tiny format-negotiation header at blob origin that advertises capabilities (gzipped, chunked, signed, index-internal)? then loader can pick streaming vs index-first without attempting expensive probes.
Sam: sounds sensible. what's the size overhead? we care about <1KB extra per shard.
Maria: proposal: 64-128 bytes, basically a capability bitfield + small CRC + optional pointer to in-blob index byte-range. small and extensible. e.g.:
```
FMT_NEGOT: 0x4A  (flags)
flags: GZIP | CHUNKED | INDEX_IN_BLOB | SIGNED
index_offset: 0x0a1f (optional)
crc32: 0x89ab
```
Kai: love that. runtime can check header on open (cheap read) and decide hotstart path. avoids trying mmap of entire blob if it's clearly streaming-optimized.
Lee: tradeoffs: clients that upload legacy safetensors won't have header; we need graceful fallback. maybe treat missing header as INDEX_FIRST_LEGACY and keep existing heuristics.
Alex: yes — default to current behavior if header absent. but add a fast-path flag we can use for canary models (where we control upload).
Sam: what about signed chunks? if SIGNED bit set, loader needs to verify before mapping into GPU memory. that can add latency on hotstart. maybe we verify on background and still map prefetched prefix?
Maria: agreed — verify-on-background for non-critical chunks; critical header + first N chunks verified synchronously. we should add policy knobs in warmup config.
Kai: implementation note: keep header read synchronous but tiny. then feed capability vector to warmup-coordinator which selects from {index-first, streaming, partial-prefetch}.
infra-bot: new CI job requested: eng-ml/format-negotiation-tests (unit + integration with s3 gzipped objects). @Sam please add hashes for signed-chunk fixture. :thumbsup:
Sam: will add fixtures. also will run a 100-concurrent-hotstart smoke on staging.
Alex: action items: (1) Maria to write RFC stub for header layout + versioning, (2) Kai to prototype warmup-coordinator hook, (3) Sam to add CI fixtures, (4) Lee to enumerate compatibility matrix for legacy loaders.
Lee: I'll draft the compatibility matrix and upload a spreadsheet link shortly.
Kai: small nit — add a feature-gate default off for Hosted until we've validated latencies.
Maria: agreed. RFC will mark feature-gate and migration plan.
Alex: thanks all. this should reduce those OOM hotstarts and make gzipped-blob adoption safer.
Kai: nice. ping me when RFC PR is up and I can slot a short demo in eng-ml sync.
Alex: will do.
